title: How to Apply for a National Police Clearance in the Philippines
description: Obtain a nationwide criminal record check through the NPCS for employment and permits.

requirements.title: NPCS Online Account
requirements.description: An active account on the National Police Clearance System portal.

requirements.title: Valid ID
requirements.description: A government-issued ID with a clear photo and signature.

requirements.title: Reference Number
requirements.description: The system-generated reference number from your appointment.

requirements.title: Payment Confirmation
requirements.description: Proof of payment of the clearance fee.

checklist.title: Create Account
checklist.description: Register on the NPCS website and complete your applicant profile.

checklist.title: Schedule Appointment
checklist.description: Book a slot at your preferred police station through the online portal.

checklist.title: Pay Fee
checklist.description: Settle the clearance fee via GCash, Maya, or other authorized payment channels.

checklist.title: Prepare ID
checklist.description: Ensure you have at least one valid government ID to present at the station.

checklist.title: Visit Police Station
checklist.description: Go to the selected station on your appointment date for biometrics and photo capture.

checklist.title: Claim Clearance
checklist.description: Receive your National Police Clearance, which is usually released on the same day if there is "No Hit."

content.title: What is a National Police Clearance?

blocks.content: A **National Police Clearance** is an official document issued by the Philippine National Police (PNP) through the National Police Clearance System (NPCS). It certifies whether an applicant has a criminal record or derogatory information in the PNP database.
Unlike older local police clearances that only covered a specific city or municipality, the National Police Clearance system performs nationwide database verification.
